actions.name: diabolical restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item .mmIceSpear000000]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a [[/item .mmTail0000000000]] attack.

actions.name: ice wall
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWallofIce0]{Wall of Ice} (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @abilities.int.dc]]).

actions.name: ice spear
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. Hit: [[/damage average]] damage. Until the end of its next turn, the target can't take a &Reference[Bonus Action] or &Reference[Reaction], its Speed decreases by 10 feet, and it can move or take one action on its turn, not both. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s hand immediately after a ranged attack.
